statement.text: Parents lose paid sessions when a child misses class, because moving a class requires calling the centre during office hours.
statement.label: HYPOTHESIS

problem.outcome_metric: Share of make-up bookings completed in-app without a phone call (baseline UNKNOWN)

audiences.text: Working parent managing one or two children's classes on Android
audiences.label: HYPOTHESIS

top_tasks.job: When my child is sick on class day, I want to move the class to another slot, so I don't lose the session I already paid for.
top_tasks.scenario: Parent at work, 2 minutes between meetings, opened from a Zalo reminder, weak 4G.
top_tasks.success_signal: New slot confirmed, old slot released, teacher notified
top_tasks.label: HYPOTHESIS

top_tasks.job: When I plan my afternoon, I want to see today's classes and rooms, so I can drop my child at the right place and time.
top_tasks.scenario: Parent at 7am on the way to work, one hand.
top_tasks.success_signal: Knows time and room for every class today
top_tasks.label: HYPOTHESIS

top_tasks.job: When a new term starts, I want to pay tuition quickly and get a receipt, so my child keeps their place.
top_tasks.scenario: Parent at home in the evening, banking app installed.
top_tasks.success_signal: Payment confirmed with receipt in app
top_tasks.label: HYPOTHESIS

failure_paths.recovery: Show next week and offer notify-me

failure_paths.trigger: Slot taken between pick and confirm
failure_paths.recovery: Return to slot list with message, keep chosen reason
Show last synced schedule with timestamp

failure_paths.trigger: Bank declines or user cancels in bank app
failure_paths.recovery: Return with invoice kept, explain, choose other method

screens.user_goal: Is anything happening today that I need to act on?
information_priority: today's classes with time and room
screens.recovery: Offline: last synced data with timestamp

screens.user_goal: Is it today, where, and can I change it?
screens.recovery: Class already started: show centre phone

screens.user_goal: Which slot fits and is the same level?
screens.recovery: No slot: next week + notify me

screens.user_goal: Am I sure, and what changes?
screens.recovery: Server error keeps choice with retry

screens.user_goal: Is it done and does the teacher know?
screens.recovery: Calendar permission denied: show manual details

screens.user_goal: How much, for what, and by when?
Which way is fastest for me?
Will I come back to the right place?
screens.feedback: Waiting for confirmation state on return
screens.recovery: Cancelled in bank: back to pay-method with explanation

screens.user_goal: Is it paid and where is the receipt?
screens.recovery: Receipt not ready: show pending with time estimate

navigation.reason: T1 and T2 are frequent peer tasks; payment is monthly so it lives in Account with a due badge on Home.

scenarios.description: First-time parent opens from a Zalo link
Returning parent rebooks between meetings, one hand
Slot taken while paying attention elsewhere; bank declines
Large text setting in bright sunlight on weak 4G
Long child name, zero slots, three children

findings.observation: 'Can't attend' read as cancel with no refund
findings.fix: Rename to 'Move this class' with helper 'Free, keeps your session'
findings.retest: S1 rerun: label read as reschedule

findings.observation: Slot taken between pick and confirm returned to Home and lost the reason
findings.fix: Return to pick-slot with message, keep reason
findings.retest: S3 rerun: lands on pick-slot with reason kept

findings.observation: Teacher and room wrap; seats badge pushed off screen at large text
findings.fix: Stack row on two lines (visual stage)

hypotheses_to_validate: All tasks and audiences are team belief
Parents expect to choose a teacher
verdict.next_validation: 5 moderated sessions with parents on T1 and T3 using a greyscale clickable prototype
